limitations: Two-dimensional bilinear two-component interpolation model, two uniformly distributed oracle calls, stationary iid pair law across steps, constant common stepsize. No extension to other operators or adaptive sampling.
scientific_integrity: The exact formula and thresholds follow from pathwise two-by-two algebra and the strong law. Standalone exact-rational tests are reproducibility checks, not infinite proof. Publication priority is qualified, especially for a 2026 abstract-only source.
title: Two distinct optimal-coupling transitions for stochastic extragradient on a bilinear game
